description: This file defines the LDAPService class within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin, providing LDAP connection, query, and binding functionalities using Symfony LDAP components.

classes.name: LDAPService
classes.description: A service class encapsulating LDAP operations such as connection, querying, binding, and escaping, utilizing Symfony LDAP components and configuration settings.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the LDAP connection instance used for communication with the LDAP server.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAP adapter based on configuration settings; implements singleton pattern.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds user credentials to LDAP for authentication.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Creates and returns an LDAP query object based on provided distinguished name and query string.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in LDAP search filters or input strings.

methods.name: getEntryManager
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP entry manager instance for managing LDAP entries.
